headline: Hyperscalers charge roughly double neocloud rates across all GPUs, while MI300X leads on price-performance.
bullets: MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, though only 5 providers list it and its marketplace median sits at just $0.50.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +166%, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 against a neocloud median of $4.02.
B200 tops the market index at $7.81 but costs $3.47 per PFLOP-hour, cheaper per unit of compute than H200 at $5.46 or H100 SXM at $4.37.
A100 80GB SXM is the least efficient option at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite a $2.70 market index, with Vast.ai cheapest at $1.19.
RunPod Community Cloud is the cheapest provider for B200, H200, H100 SXM and MI300X, posting a B200 median of $5.98 versus the $7.81 index.
watch: No 7-day change figures are reported yet, so watch whether MI300X's $0.50 marketplace median holds with only 5 providers listing it.
